headline: Every step leaves evidence.
body: Scroll the operational path. The visual stays with you while each stage highlights the system, the data path, the status, and the audit record it creates.

steps.title: Ingestion
steps.text: A user or approved service uploads or bulk-imports a document into a controlled collection.

steps.title: Encrypted storage
steps.text: Documents Service stores the immutable original in customer-controlled object storage.

steps.title: Queue processing
steps.text: The job enters an internal queue. Inference stays asynchronous and does not depend on a public API.

steps.title: OCR
steps.text: The OCR service extracts text and layout for Arabic and English documents, including poor scans.

steps.title: Classification
steps.text: The pipeline assigns a document class and routes exceptions when confidence is low.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: Fields, tables, entities, and metadata are structured and linked to the specific document version.

steps.title: Embedding
steps.text: Approved vectors are written to pgvector beside the governed PostgreSQL metadata.

steps.title: Pending review
steps.text: Structured AI output is stored as pending_review until policy allows publication or action.

steps.title: Human approval
steps.text: A reviewer approves, rejects, edits, or requests changes. The system records approved_by and the timestamp.

steps.title: Audit logging
steps.text: Model version, prompt policy, inputs, result metadata, and the human decision are append-only.

steps.title: Permission-aware search
steps.text: An authorized user searches. The API applies RBAC and content filters at query time, not only in the UI.

steps.title: Source-grounded response
steps.text: Hybrid search combines exact and semantic matches and returns citations to approved content only.

exceptions.headline: Safe outcomes when the path is uncertain
exceptions.body: The correct result may be refusal, escalation, uncertainty, or a human-review task. The system does not invent missing evidence.

items.detail: The document enters a validation queue. Reviewers correct text or metadata before it becomes searchable intelligence.

items.when: A user requests a restricted document
items.detail: The collection never enters retrieval context. The user sees a permission-safe empty or denied state.
The answer presents the conflict, cites both sources, and can route comparison output for review.
The system refuses to guess. It reports that authorized collections do not support the claim.
High-impact output stays pending_review until an accountable owner decides.
Jobs wait on internal queues. Escalation follows contracted operational procedures.
